components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one amber action per screen, full width at the bottom.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; background: var(--color-amber-9, #ffc53d); color: #21201c; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-amber-10, #ffd60a); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Primary slot while the form is not yet valid.
components.css: .ds-btn-disabled { width: 100%; background: var(--color-sand-4, #2a2a28); color: var(--color-sand-9, #6f6d66); border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Loading Button
components.description: Primary button while a request is in flight.
components.css: .ds-btn-loading { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); color: #21201c; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; cursor: progress; } .ds-spin { animation: ds-spin 1s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field: sand-2 fill, sand-4 border, amber focus border plus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-sand-11, #b5b3ad); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--color-sand-2, #191918); color: var(--color-sand-12, #eeeeec); border: 1px solid var(--color-sand-4, #2a2a28); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 16px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; caret-color: var(--color-amber-9, #ffc53d); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-amber-5, #4d3000); }

components.name: Option Card
components.description: The single selectable-list pattern; selected gets amber border, wash, and ring.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-option { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 100%; text-align: start; background: var(--color-sand-2, #191918); border: 1px solid var(--color-sand-4, #2a2a28); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--color-sand-6, #3b3a37); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-amber-5, #4d3000); } .ds-option.is-selected { border-color: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); background: var(--color-amber-2, #1d180f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-amber-5, #4d3000); } .ds-option-title { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-sand-12, #eeeeec); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-option-sub { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--color-sand-11, #b5b3ad); letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

components.name: OTP Code Input
components.description: Six cells; the next cell to fill carries the amber focus treatment and caret.
components.html: 4821
components.css: .ds-otp { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-otp-cell { flex: 1; height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-sand-2, #191918); border: 1px solid var(--color-sand-4, #2a2a28); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-sand-12, #eeeeec); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-otp-cell.is-active { border-color: var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-amber-5, #4d3000); } .ds-otp-caret { display: block; width: 2px; height: 24px; background: var(--color-amber-9, #ffc53d); animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.name: Route Chip
components.description: Route number as the bus's identity; amber fill, fixed ink.
components.html: 성북 2번 운행 중 6명 넘침
components.css: .ds-route-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-amber-9, #ffc53d); color: #21201c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-status-chip { display: inline-block; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-go { background: var(--color-green-3, #132d21); color: var(--color-green-11, #3dd68c); } .ds-status-stop { background: var(--color-red-3, #3b1219); color: var(--color-red-11, #ff9592); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed bottom nav, four equal items, translucent sand-1.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 64px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-sand-1, #111110) 80%, transparent); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-sand-3, #222221); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding-top: 2px; color: var(--color-sand-10, #7c7b74); text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--color-sand-12, #eeeeec); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-sand-11, #b5b3ad); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber-8, #8f6424); outline-offset: -2px; border-radius: 12px; }

narrative.northStar: 막차 뒤의 불빛 (The Light After the Last Bus)
narrative.overview:
DRT is used past midnight, on a phone, by a tired student standing outside. The screen is a dark, quiet field of warm gray asphalt, with exactly one light switched on: the amber of the thing to do next. That might be the primary button, the minutes until the bus leaves, or the route number on the bus. Everything else steps back into sand-gray text and hairlines so that one light can be found in a single glance.

The system is flat and tonal. Depth comes from small steps in surface lightness, never from shadows. Type is Pretendard throughout, set tight (-0.025em) and heavy where it carries a decision: big bold titles, bold button labels, and bold tabular numerals for times. Controls are large and generously rounded (12px) so they can be hit with one thumb. Copy wraps on Korean word boundaries (break-keep) and balances its lines.

Every color is defined as a light-dark() pair and the page declares color-scheme: light dark, so the app follows the OS setting. The student-facing mockups are drawn in dark mode and dark is the reference rendering, but both modes must work. The operator screens are drawn in light mode.
keyCharacteristics: One amber light per screen. Everything else is warm neutral.
Flat surfaces stacked tonally: base → raised → control. No shadows.
Large, one-handed controls: 52px+ touch targets, 12px corners, bold labels.
Tight Pretendard type, bold wherever the eye needs to land, with tabular numerals for anything that changes over time.
A single centered mobile column (max 576px), with one full-width primary action pinned at the bottom.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Each screen gets one amber-9 surface: its primary action. Amber text (amber-11) can mark one or two more key figures or links. If two things on a screen are amber-9, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Yellow-Warning Rule
rules.body: There is no yellow "caution" color, because it can't be told apart from the brand amber. Show "arriving soon" in amber-11 as emphasis, and show "almost full" with words and an icon, not a color.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on amber-9 is always #21201C, never white and never sand-12 (sand-12 turns light in dark mode). Text on green-9 or red-9 is always white.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up in a column (countdowns, clock times, rider counts such as 14/28명, the OTP timer) uses tabular-nums, so the layout doesn't shift as digits change.

rules.name: The 16px Input Floor Rule
rules.body: Text you type into is never smaller than 16px; inputs are 18px. iOS Safari zooms the page when an input with smaller text gets focus.

rules.name: The Bold First Rule
rules.body: When something needs to stand out, make it bolder before you make it bigger or color it. Bold (600–700) is the default for anything people scan for: titles, button labels, list item titles, times and counts, summary values, chips, inline actions, and small markers such as the step counter (14px, 700). Small text can be bold; the step counter is the reference. Keep 400–500 for descriptions, helper copy, and running sentences, so the bold still stands out.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Night Rule
rules.body: Never add shadows. At night on a dark screen they read as mud. To lift something, raise its surface step or give it a border.

rules.name: The Nesting Rule
rules.body: An inner element is always less rounded than its container: a 12px button inside a 16px card, inside a 24px sheet.

dos: Do use amber-9 for exactly one primary action per screen, with #21201C text.
Do keep the primary button full width, pinned at the bottom, and visible while disabled (sand-4 / sand-9) rather than hiding it.
Do show focus as an amber-8 border plus a 2px amber-5 ring on every field and selectable card.
Do reach for weight (600–700) first when a word, number, or label needs emphasis, and keep descriptions at 400–500.
Do use tabular-nums for every time, countdown, and count.
Do use break-keep and text-balance on Korean headlines and helper copy.
Do define any new color as a Radix step from src/radix-colors.css (add palettes through scripts/radix-colors.ts), so it works in both modes.
Do show time as four separate values: walk to the stop, wait for the bus, ride time, and walk home.
Do label sample operating data as 예시 데이터 on operator and demo screens.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or glows. Depth is tonal.
Don't put white or sand-12 text on amber-9.
Don't introduce a yellow or orange warning color next to the brand amber.

Don't use sand-9 for text people need to read; it is for disabled states and icons. Use sand-10 only for secondary states (placeholders, separators, inactive tab labels). It sits just under 4.5:1 (about 4.4:1 in dark mode, 3.8:1 in light), so never use it for content.
Don't make a nested element as round as or rounder than its container.
Don't render the QR code in dark mode colors.
Don't mix list styles: selectable lists are always bordered option cards, never rows with a checkmark.
